description: This Java class 'Helper' provides utility methods for handling autofill features in an Android app, including displaying messages and extracting autofillable fields from autofill requests.

classes.name: Helper
classes.description: A utility class for autofill-related helper methods in an Android autofill service.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Displays a toast message and logs it.

methods.name: getAutofillableFields
methods.description: Extracts autofillable fields from a FillRequest.

methods.name: getLatestAssistStructure
methods.description: Retrieves the latest AssistStructure from a FillRequest.

methods.name: getAutofillableFields
methods.description: Parses AssistStructure to find autofillable fields and returns a map.

methods.name: addAutofillableFields
methods.description: Recursively adds autofillable view nodes to the fields map.
